findings.issue: Required Skills lists `/skill:code-writing` as prose only, with NO markdown link to SKILL.md. Tasks 1, 2, 4, 5 all include the link. Template + checklist require the `/skill:{name}` entry to carry a link to SKILL.md.
findings.fix: Add the link, e.g. `- /skill:code-writing — [SKILL.md](~/.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md)` (mirror the form used in Task 5).

findings.issue: skills=[code-writing] but reviewers=[test-reviewer] only. The internal code-writing -> reviewers heuristic expects both code-reviewer and test-reviewer. This exactly matches the approved tech-spec (Task 3 Reviewers: test-reviewer) because the deliverable is a data-only calibration fixture, so it is defensible — flagged only for explicit confirmation.
findings.fix: Confirm test-reviewer-only is intended for the data-only fixture (no production logic). If any executable logic lands in the fixture module, add code-reviewer.

findings.issue: Heavy reliance on absolute source line numbers as anchors (e.g. `строка 248`, `строки 83–87`, `строка 165`, `242`, `284-287`). These drift the moment model_extractor.py is edited and become misleading. Template does not forbid line numbers, so this is advisory, not a violation.
findings.fix: Treat line numbers as secondary hints; anchor each reference to the stable symbol name (function/const) that is already cited alongside most of them, so the reference survives code drift.

findings.issue: Uses absolute line-range anchors (`:461-472`, `:427-455`, `:2174-2176`, `:268-325`, `:327-368`) for call sites and existing builders. Brittle to code drift. Template does not forbid; advisory.
findings.fix: Keep the symbol names (alert_cross_source_blocked / alert_cross_source_dupe / test_all_alerts_have_unique_codes) as the primary anchor; downgrade the `:NNN` ranges to approximate hints.
